facts.label: In English
facts.value: Garden of Tranquil Brightness (玉泉山 Yuquan Shan)

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: looted before 18 Oct, burned 18-19 Oct 1860 by British troops (S02 p.189; 瑞常's memorial 26 Oct via S1207); again damaged 1900 (S1201 lead); c.1930 'kept without much change as it was after the fires' (S02 p.218)

facts.label: Size
facts.value: the OSM wood on the hill, way 989069291, 39.6 ha (run): not the garden's wall

facts.label: Note
facts.value: S05 j85: 在玉泉山之阳, Kangxi-era, 16 views; gate five bays facing south, the 高水湖 before it. Pagodas on the hill (玉峰塔) are the skyline mark from our gardens. Closed today (lead).; Built 1680 as 澄心园, renamed 静明园 1692 (S1201 lead). Picture: Beato's 玉峰塔 with the rubble wall (S1212), and the pagoda on the skyline of S1211. Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 1389,470, fit rms 95 m (Yütsüanshan (Tsingmingyüan)), 98 m from the point used. Also: LoC Beijing cheng jiao tu c.1886 read at px 6822,3363, fit rms 226 m (玉泉山), 270 m from the point used.
